title: Implement main loop runner with agent spawning logic
description:
**Implementation Details:**
- Create main loop: while ready_beads_exist OR watch_mode:
  - Print "Starting agent..."
  - Launch agent (call agent launcher)
  - Wait for agent to complete
  - Print "Agent finished"
  - Check if ready beads still exist
- If not in watch mode and no ready beads: print "No ready beads, exiting" and break
- Each iteration is independent - no state maintained between runs
- Simple console output only

**Dependencies:**
- ralph-di1 (Beads integration)
- ralph-o15 (Agent launcher)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Loop runs until no ready beads exist (default mode)
- [ ] Loop runs forever with `--watch` flag
- [ ] Prints status messages at each step
- [ ] Each agent launch is independent
- [ ] Clean exit when no ready beads remain (non-watch mode)
- [ ] Can be interrupted with Ctrl+C
close_reason: Implemented main loop runner with run_single_pass() and run_watch_loop() functions. Integrates has_ready_tasks() and launch_agent_default() for full workflow. Status messages at each step. Watch mode waits 10 seconds between checks when no ready beads.

title: Implement beads integration - check for ready tasks
description:
**Implementation Details:**

- Parse output to detect if ready beads exist
- Return boolean: true if ready beads exist, false otherwise
- Handle beads not being initialized (graceful error or empty result)

**Dependencies:**
- ralph-0pn (Initialize Rust project)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Successfully invokes `bd ready` command
- [ ] Returns `true` when ready beads exist
- [ ] Returns `false` when no ready beads exist
- [ ] Handles case where beads is not initialized (no .beads directory)
- [ ] Function has proper error handling for command execution failures
close_reason: Implemented has_ready_tasks() function with proper error handling for beads integration. Returns bool indicating if ready tasks exist, handles NotInitialized and BeadsNotAvailable errors.

title: Implement signal handling for graceful shutdown
description:
**Implementation Details:**
- Set up signal handlers for SIGINT (Ctrl+C) and SIGTERM
- On signal receipt:
  - Print "Shutdown signal received, waiting for agent to finish..."
  - If agent is running: wait for it to complete (don't kill it)
  - After agent exits: break the loop cleanly
  - Optional: detach tmux session (keep it alive for inspection)
- Use Rust's signal handling (tokio::signal or signal-hook crate)
- Ensure proper cleanup before exit

**Dependencies:**
- ralph-cio (Main loop runner - signals affect the loop)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Ctrl+C during agent execution waits for agent to finish
- [ ] After agent finishes, loop exits cleanly
- [ ] No zombie processes left behind
- [ ] Tmux session remains intact for inspection (not killed)
- [ ] Multiple Ctrl+C presses work correctly (don't double-handle)
- [ ] Graceful shutdown message is displayed
close_reason: Implemented signal handling for SIGINT and SIGTERM using signal-hook crate. Signals are handled gracefully: when received, shutdown flag is set, message is displayed, and the loop waits for the current agent to finish before exiting cleanly. Multiple signal presses are handled idempotently, and the tmux session remains intact after shutdown.

title: Implement Claude Code agent launcher with fixed prompt
description:
**Implementation Details:**
- Create function to launch Claude Code agent within tmux session
- Use fixed prompt: "Run bd ready, choose a bead, begin work on only that bead. Exit when done."
- Invoke via `claude` command in tmux session
- Wait for agent to complete (exit) before returning
- Agent runs interactively in tmux (user can attach and watch)

**Dependencies:**
- ralph-2pt (CLI interface)
- ralph-tzz (Tmux integration)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Claude Code agent launches in `ralph` tmux session
- [ ] Agent receives the fixed prompt as input
- [ ] Function waits for agent to exit before continuing
- [ ] Agent can be observed by attaching to tmux session (`tmux attach -t ralph`)
- [ ] Returns success/failure based on agent exit code
- [ ] Clear error if `claude` command is not available
close_reason: Implemented launch_agent() function that spawns Claude Code agents in tmux session with fixed prompt. Checks for claude availability, ensures tmux session exists, sends command, and waits for agent completion via pgrep polling. Default 5-minute timeout.

title: Implement tmux session creation and reuse logic
description:
**Implementation Details:**
- Create function to check if tmux session named `ralph` exists
- If session exists: attach/reuse it
- If session does not exist: create new session with name `ralph`
- Function to execute commands within the tmux session
- Handle tmux not being installed (graceful error)

**Dependencies:**
- ralph-0pn (Initialize Rust project)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] First run creates new tmux session named `ralph`
- [ ] Subsequent runs reuse existing `ralph` session
- [ ] Commands execute successfully within the tmux session
- [ ] Clear error message if tmux is not installed

close_reason: Implemented tmux session management with ensure_session(), create_session(), session_exists(), and send_command() functions. Proper error handling with clear messages for tmux not installed. Session name 'ralph' is configurable via RALPH_SESSION_NAME constant.
